EpisodeBranchPoint.description: Where a branched episode left its parent.

at_seq.description: Last parent event visible to the child.

EpisodePins.description:
Versions an episode is pinned to; switching is an explicit, visible event.

v2 replaces C0's `skills_version` (never written: it was always absent) with `harness`.

EpisodeStatus.description:
Operational state of an episode. It constrains actions, not reasoning: inside `running` the agent
decides whether to read, compute, ask or answer.

oneOf.description: The last turn finished; the episode can be continued by a new message.

HarnessRef.description:
The harness an episode runs with (K1.6): the instruction/skill bundle by digest plus the runtime
build, model and effort it was injected into. Every benchmark number is reported with this.

digest.description: Digest of the harness bundle (`harness/`: instructions, skills, agents) as injected.

effort.description: Reasoning effort as the runtime names it, when it has one.

label.description: Human label of the bundle or variant (`h1`, `h1-no-wiki`); not an identity.

model.description: Model id as the runtime reports it.

Origin.description:
Who produced a payload. `synthetic_fixture` marks hand-made contract examples; such payloads (and
anything computed from them) can never be presented as NASA results or qualify a model.
Produced-by-the-system payloads are `system` even when their *data* is synthetic (that is
`EvidenceClass::Synthetic` / `TrainedOn::Synthetic`).

ResearchSchema.description:
Wire tag of episodes, events, answers and traces. Wave K1 writes `research.v2`; `research.v1`
(C0) documents are still read. A v2 addition (tool arguments, step rationale, a view block, a
support check, a harness pin) is refused under the v1 tag, so a v1 reader never receives a
document it would misread.

oneOf.description: C0. Still read; new documents are written as v2.

RuntimeKind.description:
Agent runtime hosting an episode (ADR 17): the pinned Codex App Server, or Claude Code in
headless mode. Each owns its own model/tool loop; IGNIS maps, stores and audits both the same way.

RuntimeThreadRef.description: Mapping of an episode to its runtime thread. Turn/item ids travel in `Causation`.

description: One scientific investigation. Holds no provider keys and no copy of the runtime transcript.

last_seq.description: Highest committed event `seq` (0 before the first event).
